title_en: Official Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Disposal of the Estates of Rural Five-Guarantee Recipients

articles.content_en: Article 18 The personal property of a Five-Guarantee beneficiary may be continued to be used by the beneficiary, but the beneficiary shall not dispose of it on its own; the property that needs to be managed on behalf of the beneficiary may be managed on behalf of the beneficiary by a rural collective economic organization.

Article 19 After the death of a Five-Guarantee beneficiary, the estate shall vest in the rural collective economic organization to which the beneficiary belongs; if there is a Five-Guarantee support agreement, it shall be handled in accordance with the agreement.
